question: Will this stack of three boxes stay standing, or will it fall?
explanation: Rule: a stack is stable only if the centre of mass of everything above each box lies over that box's top face. Here, everything above level 2 has centre of mass x = 0.05 m while the box below spans -0.53 to 0.97 m; everything above level 1 has centre of mass x = 0.14 m while the box below spans -0.75 to 0.75 m. Every check passes, so it stays standing.
